create.title: Complete actual-symbol signed cancellation on primitive square rays
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt X, 1<=L<=H<=J^(1/2), and use the accepted complete collar-extracted top-M2 primitive-ray coefficient. Restrict to primitive rays with ab a square, equivalently a=s^2, b=t^2, t=s+2u, with s,t odd, (s,u)=1, and 1<=u<s/2. For each actual odd lift g and reciprocal interval Ju/s<k<2Ju/t, the exact combined phase is e(-gXu^2/k). Put K=Ju/s and B_g(k)=B^circ_(s^2,t^2,k)(g). The complete smooth-collar coefficient satisfies sup_k |B_g(k)|+Var_k B_g(k) <<_epsilon X^epsilon sqrt(g t^2/K), including both collar crossings, floors, stars, q_X, and the exact W and normalized eta/Phi profiles. Since |d_k^2(-gXu^2/k)| is comparable to g t^2/K and is at most one, weighted second-derivative summation gives sum_k B_g(k)e(-gXu^2/k) <<_epsilon (L+1)X^epsilon for every fixed (s,u,g). The number of actual lifted square triples is O(L log(2+L)); hence the exact signed square-family contribution is O_epsilon(L^2 X^epsilon). This includes exact and metric reciprocal resonances and uses no cancellation between distinct lifts or rays. It proves no nonsquare, full-energy, M9-M2, endpoint, or exponent estimate.

create.title: Sharp capacity obstruction to absolute Abel summation on square rays
create.statement_tex: For the standard fixed top-M2 dyadic support with a positive interior terminal box, the positive square-ray Abel majorant M_L^square defined by the Round-77 step-two variation bound has capacity asymp_(X^epsilon) sqrt(J)L^(3/2). The upper bound follows from min(N,(2||theta||)^(-1))<=N<<G, G<<L/t^2, and the exact reciprocal interval length. For the lower bound, a terminal g=1 box contains >>L coprime odd (s,u) pairs with s,u,s-2u asymp sqrt L; each owns N,G asymp1, a k-interval of length asymp J, and positive mass >>sqrt(JL). Already one fixed populated (9,11) ray along X=T^4 gives >>X^(1/4) at fixed L. Therefore M_L^square<<L^2X^epsilon is false. This is a route obstruction only: the actual signed square sum is target-sized by cancellation in k.
